items.headline: NFL Week 2 uniforms: Rams debut 'Classic Sol,' Ravens go all-white
items.description: Here's a look at what each NFL team is wearing in Week 2, led by a new alternate look from the Los Angeles Rams.

items.headline: Colts brace for a new-look Chiefs attack after Kenneth Walker III’s 173-yard opener against Denver
items.description: — The Indianapolis Colts had a chance to watch the Kansas City Chiefs open the season with a rout of the Denver Broncos on TV on Monday night, and they came away having learned the same lesson as most everybody else who watched the game.

items.headline: Colts make major change after defensive dysfunction
items.description: Stephen Holder reports Indianapolis is moving defensive play-calling duties from Cam Bynum to Akeem Davis-Gaither.

items.headline: Chiefs expecting rookie CB Mansoor Delane to play on SNF
items.description: Rookie cornerback Mansoor Delane, who aggravated a shoulder injury after recording his first career interception, is on track to play on "Sunday Night Football" against the Colts, coach Andy Reid says.

items.headline: Colts' Keenan Allen formally charged, faces two misdemeanors
items.description: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen was formally charged with two misdemeanor drunken driving charges on Wednesday.

items.headline: Colts' D looked lost vs. Ravens, and Patrick Mahomes is next
items.description: Communication problems hurt the Colts vs. Lamar Jackson, and that likely piqued Patrick Mahomes' curiosity.
